meta.what: Chronicle templates (P11, plan B without network): one sentence per StoryBeat, in the second person. They only use the numbers carried by the beats, never new ones.

placeholders.cash: data.cash, as CHF (EN: CHF 1’234, ES: 1’234 CHF, as in events.json)
placeholders.goal: labels.goal[data.goal] (the dataset goal name if there is no label)
placeholders.option: events.json label of the option chosen (data.option of the DECISION beat)
placeholders.narrative: events.json narrative of the case (data.case) of the option chosen for that event
placeholders.flag: facts.json label of the milestone data.flag
placeholders.because: the 'because' text with the event title when the beat was caused by an event other than the decision being told (e.g. a job that starts two years after the master's), otherwise empty

meta.check: python tools/chronicle.py --check; render a real game: python tools/chronicle.py --play <profile_id> --choices A,B --lang ES

START.EN: You start at {age}, in {year}, with {cash} in your account.
START.ES: Empiezas con {age} años, en {year}, con {cash} en tu cuenta.

DECISION.EN: At {age} ({year}) a decision came up, “{event}”, and you chose: {option}.
DECISION.ES: A los {age} años ({year}) llegó una decisión, «{event}», y elegiste: {option}.

QUIET_PERIOD.EN: At {age} two quiet years began, with no big decisions.
QUIET_PERIOD.ES: A los {age} años empezaron dos años tranquilos, sin grandes decisiones.

CASH_NEGATIVE.EN: At {age} your account went into the red ({cashAbs} below zero) and you started paying interest on it.
CASH_NEGATIVE.ES: A los {age} años tu cuenta quedó en números rojos ({cashAbs} por debajo de cero) y empezaste a pagar intereses.

CASH_RECOVERED.EN: At {age} your account was back above zero ({cash}).
CASH_RECOVERED.ES: A los {age} años tu cuenta volvió a estar en positivo ({cash}).

LOW_POINT.EN: Your lowest point came at {age}, with {cash} in your account.
LOW_POINT.ES: Tu peor momento llegó a los {age} años, con {cash} en tu cuenta.

GOAL_REACHED.ES: A los {age} años alcanzaste tu meta: {goal} ({target}).

GOAL_MISSED.EN: At {age} the date of your goal passed before you reached it: {goal} ({target}).
GOAL_MISSED.ES: A los {age} años llegó la fecha de tu meta sin haberla alcanzado: {goal} ({target}).

END.EN: {years} years later, at {age}, your net worth is {netWorth}, {cash} of it in cash.
END.ES: {years} años después, con {age} años, tu patrimonio es de {netWorth}, de los que {cash} están en efectivo.

EDUCATION.EN: At {age} your studies reached a new stage: {value}{because}.
EDUCATION.ES: A los {age} años tus estudios cambiaron de etapa: {value}{because}.

OCCUPATION.ES: A los {age} años tu carrera avanzó: {value}{because}.

CITY.ES: A los {age} años te mudaste a {value}{because}.

HOUSING.ES: A los {age} años cambió tu vivienda: {value}{because}.

FAMILY.ES: A los {age} años cambió tu familia: {value}{because}.

EMPLOYED.ES: empezaste a trabajar a tiempo completo

PART_TIME.ES: empezaste a trabajar a tiempo parcial

SELF_EMPLOYED.ES: empezaste a trabajar por tu cuenta

UNEMPLOYED.EN: you were left without a job

SINGLE.EN: you started living on your own

COUPLE.EN: you moved in with your partner
COUPLE.ES: te fuiste a vivir con tu pareja

FAMILY.EN: you started a family with children

SHARED_HOUSING.EN: you moved into a shared flat
SHARED_HOUSING.ES: te mudaste a un piso compartido
